title: The self-typing bubble
goal:
Thursday 5 Nov (docs/plans/2026-11-02-week/thu-no-spending-no-sending.md, beats 1, 5, 6, 7, 10). A message, an order confirmation, an email banner or a settings choice that builds itself on screen, in real-UI style. Every one is a simulation: made-up names only, no real account. A library device.

1. `params`: `kind` one of `chat`, `notification`, `order`, `email`, `choice`; `rows`: 1 to 6 `{who?, text, side?}` (who is a made-up label; text at most 80 characters); `status?` short label such as Sent or Arriving tomorrow; `options?` for `choice`: 2 to 4 strings with one `picked` index.
2. `enter`: the card rises in with a soft shadow.
3. `type` with `toState` = row index: that row's text types on character by character over its event span, with a typing-dots lead-in for `chat`.
4. `send`: the status label appears with a small whoosh offset (Sent, Arriving tomorrow).
5. `pick` with `toState` = option index: the radio dot fills on that option (for the policy chooser, sections A, B and C).
6. `exit`: falls away.

## Tests
- no text before its `type`; a row typed halfway shows half its characters (deterministic)
- `pick` fills exactly one dot; `send` shows the status
- every colour from tokens; tall and wide fixtures render
contract: Rules for every device (apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md): `Device({object, events, box, tokens, aspect, frame})`, a pure function of its props; state only from `stateAt(events, object.obj, frame)`, animation only from `progress()` and `drift()` with `MOTION` timing; colours only from `tokens` (raw hex refused); type roles from `HOUSE_FONTS`; no `Math.random`, no `f % N`, no wall clock; author 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 slots separately. Register the device in `devices/registry.ts` (one line) and in `config/ve/devices.json` with exactly the verbs below, and update `verbs.test.ts`. No person, no real brand mascot, no on-screen text beyond what params give. Look: the house tokens on a light ground, soft shadows, real-UI realism, as in Krish's references (light-grey kinetic explainer with a cute cursor character; app logos orbiting a central icon on rings with motion blur on arrival).
